reasons: Status is correctly characterized as a deviation: Section 5.1 provides only a care-and-skill/authority warranty with no conformance or malicious-code warranty and no stated remedy, and Section 5.4(c)'s unqualified 'AS IS' language for Materials would swallow any express protection.

The redline reaches the playbook position with two targeted operations: a new Section 5.1(c) containing a 90-day conformance warranty, a no-malicious-code warranty, and an express re-performance/repair/replace/refund remedy, plus an 'EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1' carve-out prefixed to the disclaimer — matching the redline guidance (extend/add remedy, carve out of disclaimer).
The failed period regex is a false negative from phrasing: the inserted text says 'for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery,' which satisfies the ≥90-day parameter.

The reported 0.613 changed-character ratio on p0074 overstates the edit: only a short prefix was added and the remainder of the disclaimer (including the pre-existing '&sbsp;' artifact) is preserved verbatim, so the edit is minimal in substance.
The comment is accurate, correctly cites Sections 5.1 and 5.4(c), explains what changed and why, and offers the fallback of a shorter period, consistent with tone requirements.

Minor, non-blocking: the insertion uses 'Deliverable' alongside the agreement's defined 'Materials'; aligning solely to 'Materials' (and, if desired, adding the express carve-out to the Section 5.2/p0065 exclusivity language) would tighten the fit but does not undermine the edit's validity.
